analyst.summary: Redington is one of India's largest technology-product distributors, moving PCs, smartphones, cloud services, cybersecurity software and enterprise IT gear from global manufacturers to resellers across India, the Middle East and Africa. Its most recent quarter was a record one, with revenue and profit both growing strongly, driven by cloud and cybersecurity demand and large enterprise deals, at a stock price that is not expensive relative to earnings. Being a distribution business, margins are thin by nature and some of the current strength reflects favourable short-term supply conditions in memory chips and premium smartphones. We rate it a Hold: a genuinely improving, reasonably priced business with a thin-margin model that leaves less room for error.
